basic_details.job_title: TMC ACTREC Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 – Walk-in

age_limit.details: The upper age limit is up to 30 years.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | lab technician (microbiology lab): B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent from recognized university/ Institute/ State Board of Technical Education. Candidates with Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Technology are also eligible. One Year Experience in diagnostic Laboratory is preferred.

vacancy_details.details: The notification does not specify the total number of vacancies available for the post of Lab Technician in the Microbiology Lab.

salary_details.lab technician (microbiology lab): ₹ 26,210 to 32,000/- p.m. (on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria)
salary_details.details: The duration of the contract is 6 months, which is extendable as per requirement.

how_to_apply: Prepare your Bio-data along with a recent passport size photograph.
Gather scanned copies of your Aadhar Card and PAN CARD.
Keep your ORIGINAL and Self Attested copies of qualification certificates and experience certificates ready.
Attend the walk-in interview on Friday, 16th October 2026.
Report between 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. at 3rd floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.
important_instructions: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualifications and experience requirements before attending the walk-in interview. Candidates must report strictly within the designated reporting time between 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. Both original certificates and self-attested copies are mandatory for verification during the interview. The position is placed on contract at Tata Memorial Centre- ACTREC, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai through an outsourced contractor (A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd.).

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment being conducted by TMC ACTREC?
faq.answer: TMC ACTREC is conducting a walk-in interview for the post of Lab Technician in the Microbiology Lab on an outsourced contract basis through A-1 Facility and Property Managers Pvt. Ltd.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The total number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for Friday, 16th October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the reporting time for the interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time is from 10:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q5. What is the venue for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the 3rd floor, Paymaster Shodhika, TMC-ACTREC, Sec-22, Kharghar, Navi Mumbai- 410210.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (Microbiology / Biotechnology) with DMLT/equivalent from a recognized university, institute, or State Board of Technical Education, or a Bachelor’s degree in Medical Laboratory Technology.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is up to 30 years.

faq.question: Q8. What is the consolidated salary offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary ranges from ₹ 26,210 to 32,000/- p.m., determined on the basis of experience over and above the specified eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: The duration of the contract is 6 months, which is extendable as per requirement.
